name: B10-0538/2025 (PPE) – Rule of law and human rights situation in Tunisia, particularly the case of Sonia Dahmani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the rule of law and human rights situation in Tunisia, particularly the case of Sonia Dahmani
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Sonia Dahmani, a well-known Tunisian lawyer and journalist held in prison since May 2024. She was convicted over things she said in the media and could face up to twenty-four years in total. The Parliament also says Tunisia must respect human rights and the rule of law, and it raises concerns about her health and her access to medical care. This is an opinion, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks Tunisia to free Sonia Dahmani and protect her health.
- **Who it affects:** Sonia Dahmani, her family, and Tunisia's government and courts.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU leaders and Tunisian authorities; Tunisia decides whether to act.
